response.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name AS race_name, AVG(CASE WHEN TRIM(res.laps) GLOB '[0-9]*' AND TRIM(res.laps) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' THEN CAST(res.laps AS REAL) END) AS average_laps FROM results AS res JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE res.positionOrder >= 12 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name ORDER BY average_laps IS NULL, average_laps DESC, r.raceId LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff includes classification position 12. Missing lap values are NULL or nonnumeric text.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff means positions strictly after 12.
